messages:
alice: kicking off change window for v2.3.0 (eu-west) — canary at 5% now. watching p95, 5xx, and error-budget. I pushed release notes to the doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0 :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: service=embed-route target=5% shards=3 image=redwood/serve:v2.3.0 ts=4351234567
observability-bot: alert: p95 latency for embed-route +130ms vs baseline over last 3m (svc: eu-west, series: p95) — investigate? :rotating_light:
carol: saw the spike on dashboards. p95 from 210ms -> 340ms. 5xx still low (0.12%) but error-budget burn for this window is 18% in last 5m.
bob: can you paste the dashboard panel link? want to see traces.
carol: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/embed-route?range=5m — traces show a tail on kv-cache miss for long prompts, and one node with higher GPU queue.
derek: running a quick health check and rollout status:```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/embed-route
kubectl get pods -l app=embed-route -o wide
```
deploy-bot: canary: pod 2/3 restart count increased by 1 on shard-2 at 4351234589. logs: `OOMKilled` (java/native runtime)
alice: ok. shard-2 restart and kv-cache miss correlates. recommendation: pause traffic shift and pin traffic back to v2.2.9 for embed-route while we triage?
carol: agree. trigger pause and pin. threshold we agreed: >1% 5xx OR >25% error-budget burn in 10m -> rollback. we're under 1% but error-budget trending fast.
bob: i can cut the pin. doing `deploy-bot pin embed-route v2.2.9 --scope eu-west`
deploy-bot: pin applied for embed-route -> v2.2.9 (eu-west). traffic shift halted. Canary stopped at current 5%.
derek: I've collected pod logs and kernel OOM traces, uploading to /artifacts/4351234567/oom-shard-2.log
carol: creating a short rollback note in the release doc and flagging infra with SRE. release notes `v2.3.0 -- embed-route canary paused due to p95 bump; pinned back to v2.2.9 in eu-west`
alice: thanks. can someone open an ops ticket and assign to eng-runtime? prefer a short postmortem if we end up rolling back fully.
bob: ticket created: OPS-7834, assigned eng-runtime. adding traces and restart logs.
observability-bot: synthetic check resumed on pinned variant v2.2.9. p95 back to baseline ~215ms after pin — continuing to monitor.
carol: leaving this thread open. if any additional 5xx or error-budget burn >10% in next 15m we escalate to full rollback. :thumbsup:
